memories.author: D05
memories.text: Hypothyroidism, hypertension and vitamin B12 deficiency. Patient reports fatigue, weight gain, occasional palpitations. BP 138/86 mmHg, pulse 78/min, BMI 27.2 kg/m2. No edema. Chest clear. S1S2 normal. No goiter.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Levothyroxine 50 mcg OD
Amlodipine 5 mg OD
Telmisartan 40 mg OD
Methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I have been feeling tired for the past two months and need to nap after work. My weight has gone up by about 4 kg despite no change in diet. I sometimes feel my heart racing when I climb stairs. I have been taking the tablets as prescribed but wonder if the dose is enough.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow‑up appointment booked for 2025-07-10 at 10:00 AM with Dr Suresh Menon (D05).

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Persistent hypothyroidism. Improved fatigue after levothyroxine start but still mild tiredness. BP 132/84 mmHg. No new symptoms. Lung fields clear. Cardiac rhythm regular.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: 12‑lead ECG: sinus rhythm, rate 76 bpm. No ST‑T changes. Left ventricular voltage within normal limits. No pathological Q waves.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I feel a bit more energetic now, but I still get sleepy in the afternoons. My blood pressure readings at home have been around 130/82. No chest pain or palpitations noticed recently.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: TSH now at target. Patient reports good energy, no fatigue. BP 128/80 mmHg. No adverse effects. Lung clear. No thyroid enlargement.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Refer to Endocrinology for optimisation of thyroid replacement and to rule out autoimmune thyroiditis. Request TPO antibodies and thyroid ultrasound.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I feel much better now; my energy levels are back to normal and I have lost the extra weight I gained. No side effects from the medicines. I am happy with the current plan.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Patient reviewed after endocrine review. TSH stable, antibodies negative, ultrasound normal. Hypertension well controlled. No symptoms. Advise to continue current meds and annual review.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Endocrinology report: TPO antibodies <5 IU/mL (negative). Thyroid ultrasound shows homogeneous gland, no nodules. Advise continue levothyroxine 100 mcg OD. No further action needed.
